appraisal_events.evidence: Cet art était devenu mince et minable. Aucune âme profonde ne l'habitait plus. / depuis mes visites chez Elstir, c'est sur certaines tapisseries, sur certains tableaux modernes, que j'avais reporté la foi intérieure que j'avais eue jadis en ce jeu, en cet art tragique de la Berma.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator explicitly records that his once-passionate devotion to Berma's acting has withered into indifference, declaring her art 'thin and paltry' now that his inner faith has migrated to Elstir's paintings.

appraisal_events.evidence: le grand seigneur, doux, souriant, avait l'air de considérer, d'exercer l'affectation de l'humilité et de la patience... comme un privilège de sa bonne éducation. / Je le savais grand ami des Guermantes.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator admiringly contrasts this presumed aristocrat's graceful, humble bearing with the brusque hauteur he attributes to rich financiers, and reinforces the man's prestige through his supposed closeness to the Guermantes; the identity attribution itself remains hedged.

status_effects.explanation: Her art is now judged 'mince et minable,' stripped in the narrator's eyes of the depth he once revered in it.
The narrator's aesthetic devotion formerly given to Berma has been transferred to Elstir's tapestries and paintings, comparatively elevating Elstir's standing in the narrator's inner hierarchy.

The narrator attributes refined, effortlessly humble aristocratic manner to this figure and links him to the prestigious Guermantes circle, elevating his local standing, though his identity as the prince de Saxe is itself uncertain.

ambiguities: The stranger's identity as the prince de Saxe is explicitly hedged by the narrator ('ou supposé tel', 'Il était peut-être le prince de Saxe'), and whether the duchesse de Guermantes is genuinely the cousin he refers to is left as pure narratorial conjecture ('c'était peut-être...que ses yeux voyaient en pensée'); the elevation in E2 attaches to a figure whose identity is not confirmed by the text.
